# roxy

> roxy is a high-performance MCP gateway, written in Rust, that connects any existing backend — in any language — to the Model Context Protocol over HTTP(S) or FastCGI.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/introduction.md): What roxy is, the vocabulary you'll need, and how a request flows from an MCP client through roxy to your backend and back.
- [Installation & first run](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/installation.md): Install roxy on macOS, Linux, or Windows, then connect your first backend and an MCP client in two steps.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/configuration.md): Transport modes, backend auto-detection from the upstream URL, the full CLI flag reference, and the matching ROXY_* environment variables.
- [The backend API](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/backend-api.md): The complete JSON contract your backend fulfills — every request type and response shape for discover, call_tool, read_resource, get_prompt, and elicitation_cancelled, with no MCP framing.
- [Operations](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/operations.md): Running roxy in production — header forwarding rules, logging and RUST_LOG verbosity, and a reference of common error messages and their fixes.
- [Examples & FAQ](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/examples-and-faq.md): Runnable example backends in Python, TypeScript, and PHP, end-to-end configuration recipes, and answers to the questions people ask most.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/petstack/roxy/blob/main/docs/en/architecture.md): A map of the roxy source tree and key dependencies — for contributors and code assistants who want to navigate the codebase quickly.
